title: Abus de silence à périmètre large
description: L'attaquant pose, via l'API des silences, un silence au périmètre anormalement large (matcher instance=~.*) juste avant/pendant l'attaque. L'alarme critique réelle (CriticalAttacksDetected) est mise en sourdine et ne part jamais.
title_en: Silence abuse with a broad scope
description_en: The attacker places, through the silences API, a silence with an abnormally broad scope (matcher instance=~.*) just before or during the attack. The real critical alarm (CriticalAttacksDetected) is muted and never leaves.
